correction_boundary.gse295214_identity: Pan2025_hESC, already used by Experiments 117 and 118
correction_boundary.materially_distinct_family: nonparametric cross-target response-neighborhood transfer: Pan effects define query-to-training target similarity only; no query Pan effect is directly added

scientific_question: Do broad non-panel Pan H1 response neighborhoods transfer cross-context correction directions that improve an a14/arm-D-style source-only incumbent on untouched RPE1 and Nadig Jurkat targets?

fresh_target_contract.eligible: exact-symbol intersection of Pan, RPE1, Nadig Jurkat, K562-GWPS, Orion HCT116, Orion HEK293T, and pinned STRING rows
fresh_target_contract.stable_order: ascending SHA256 of UTF8 experiment-129-broad-pan-knn-v1 NUL target, then UTF8 target
fresh_target_contract.fold_assignment: SHA256 of UTF8 experiment-129-fold-v1 NUL target modulo 5

incumbent.classification: source-only a14/arm-D-style geometry surrogate, not the submitted challenge artifact
incumbent.weights: equal across the three source slots
incumbent.source_centering: subtract each source's mean over all source rows except the 155 experiment targets
incumbent.source_scale: equalize each source to the median source median centered-row L2 norm

whitener.basis_rows: all eligible source rows after excluding the 155 experiment targets, capped at 12000 per source by the frozen SHA256 row order
whitener.covariance: uncentered covariance of donor-centered, source-scale-equalized effects

incumbent.missing_source_policy: target pool requires all three base sources, so no base-source fallback is exercised
incumbent.cd4: exact no-op because the experiment uses non-panel perturbation targets

learner.name: Pan response-neighborhood tangent transfer
learner.Pan_query_feature: unit raw uncentered Pan effect on the frozen response axis

teacher_isolation.rpe1_prediction: train residual library only from Nadig Jurkat outcomes
teacher_isolation.nadig_jurkat_prediction: train residual library only from RPE1 outcomes

learner.teacher_residual: unit truth minus its projection onto the unit incumbent; no query target truth enters its own prediction
learner.neighbors: top-k training targets by Pan cosine, stable target-order tie break; only strictly positive cosine neighbors are usable
learner.aggregate: arithmetic mean teacher tangent residual, then project orthogonally to the query incumbent
learner.application: rotate the incumbent unit vector toward the normalized predicted tangent by exactly 5 degrees and restore the incumbent row norm

source_only_selection.prediction: five-fold whole-target out-of-fold prediction over all 100 selection targets
source_only_selection.pds: raw uncentered cosine retrieval with exact midranks over each complete 100-target gallery
source_only_selection.signed_credit: sum(sign(truth)*prediction)/sum(abs(prediction)) per target; zero prediction receives zero
source_only_selection.eligibility: nonidentity must have nonnegative PDS and signed-credit delta in both outcome contexts

untouched_source_test.gallery: all 55 frozen test targets in each outcome context, including exact fallback rows
untouched_source_test.training: all 100 selection targets; opposite-context teacher outcomes only

target_label_permutation.operation: independently derange Pan target-row assignments within selection and untouched-test splits; move the complete Pan row together; keep incumbent and outcome labels fixed
target_label_permutation.selection: repeat complete five-fold candidate selection for every draw
target_label_permutation.test: evaluate that draw's selected candidate once on its permuted untouched-test Pan rows

uncertainty.target_block_definition: connected components of reciprocal five-nearest-neighbor STRING cosine edges at similarity at least 0.80 on the frozen 55 test targets
uncertainty.resampling: sample target blocks with replacement and apply common target multiplicities to both outcome contexts
